text:
### SAR Filing Process  
**Step 1: Report Preparation**
- Detailed narrative of suspicious activity
- Timeline of transactions
- Customer and transaction details
- Supporting evidence
- Risk assessment
- Recommendation (ML suspected, TF suspected, or other)  
**Step 2: Internal Approval**
- Compliance Head review and approval
- Chief Risk Officer sign-off (if significant)
- CEO notification (if high-profile)  
**Step 3: NCA Submission**
- Filed via Suspicious Activity Report Online (SARs Online)
- Filed within 30 days of suspicion arising
- Submission confirmed by NCA  
**Step 4: Follow-Up**
- NCA may request additional information
- Bank cooperates fully with any investigation
- Document retention (5 years minimum)

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing Process
raw_entities.description: The bank's formal process for preparing, approving, and submitting Suspicious Activity Reports to the NCA. The process comprises four sequential steps: report preparation with detailed narrative and risk assessment, internal approval by Compliance Head and Chief Risk Officer, submission via SARs Online within 30 days of suspicion, and follow-up cooperation with NCA investigations.
context: Filed via Suspicious Activity Report Online (SARs Online)
Filed within 30 days of suspicion arising
Bank cooperates fully with any investigation

raw_entities.name: SAR Filing Deadline
raw_entities.description: The mandatory timeframe within which a Suspicious Activity Report must be submitted to the NCA following the identification of suspicious activity. Reports must be filed within 30 days of suspicion arising.
context: Filed within 30 days of suspicion arising

raw_entities.name: SAR Report Preparation
raw_entities.description: The requirement to prepare a detailed SAR containing a narrative of suspicious activity, transaction timeline, customer and transaction details, supporting evidence, risk assessment, and a recommendation regarding suspected money laundering or terrorist financing.
context: Recommendation (ML suspected, TF suspected, or other)

raw_entities.name: SAR Internal Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: The mandatory internal approval process requiring Compliance Head review and approval, Chief Risk Officer sign-off for significant cases, and CEO notification for high-profile reports before submission to the NCA.

raw_entities.name: SAR NCA Submission Requirement
raw_entities.description: The obligation to file Suspicious Activity Reports to the NCA via the SARs Online system within 30 days of suspicion arising, with confirmation of submission by the NCA.
context: Filed via Suspicious Activity Report Online (SARs Online)
Filed within 30 days of suspicion arising

raw_entities.name: SAR Follow-Up and Cooperation
raw_entities.description: The requirement for the bank to cooperate fully with NCA requests for additional information and investigations following SAR submission, and to retain all supporting documentation for a minimum of 5 years.
context: Bank cooperates fully with any investigation

raw_entities.name: SAR Document Retention
raw_entities.description: The mandatory requirement to retain all Suspicious Activity Report documentation and supporting evidence for a minimum of 5 years following submission.

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering
raw_entities.description: The risk of money laundering identified through suspicious activity, which triggers the requirement to prepare and file a Suspicious Activity Report with a recommendation of suspected ML.
context: Recommendation (ML suspected, TF suspected, or other)

raw_entities.name: Terrorist Financing
raw_entities.description: The risk of terrorist financing identified through suspicious activity, which triggers the requirement to prepare and file a Suspicious Activity Report with a recommendation of suspected TF.
context: Recommendation (ML suspected, TF suspected, or other)

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for reviewing and approving Suspicious Activity Reports before submission to the NCA as part of the internal approval gate.

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for providing sign-off on significant Suspicious Activity Reports as part of the internal approval process.

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for notification in cases of high-profile Suspicious Activity Reports as part of the internal approval process.

raw_entities.name: National Crime Agency
raw_entities.description: The external regulatory authority to which Suspicious Activity Reports are filed via the SARs Online system. The NCA confirms receipt of submissions and may request additional information or conduct investigations.
context: Filed via Suspicious Activity Report Online (SARs Online)

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Online System
raw_entities.description: The online system used by the bank to file Suspicious Activity Reports to the NCA. Reports must be submitted via this system within 30 days of suspicion arising.
context: Filed via Suspicious Activity Report Online (SARs Online)
